title: Everyone Watches Women’s Sports, Including ‘Ted Lasso’ Fans
summary: The show’s focus on a women’s squad mirrors a broader increase in the popularity of women’s team sports. Now the series faces a challenge: pleasing old fans while welcoming new ones.
